hero.intro: Hi, I'm Ahmed Sumon — a web developer with 3+ years of industry experience building WordPress, Shopify and custom websites for international clients. From design and development to eCommerce, SEO and performance, I deliver complete digital solutions.

about.headline: Passionate developer. Reliable partner.
about.bio1: I'm Ahmed Sumon, a web developer and digital specialist based in Bangladesh, working with clients worldwide. I bring together design thinking, solid code and growth-focused strategy to build websites that don't just look good — they perform.
about.bio2: Over 3+ years I've built 21+ websites across e-commerce, SaaS, services and creative industries — each one crafted to meet real business goals, on time and on budget.

faq.q: What types of websites do you build?
faq.a: I build a wide range — from simple landing pages to complex eCommerce stores. My main focus is WordPress (including Elementor and WooCommerce), Shopify, and custom HTML/CSS/JS sites. I've worked with clients in services, retail, education, healthcare, creative industries and more.

faq.q: How long does a typical project take?
faq.a: A simple landing page or small business website typically takes 1–2 weeks. A full WordPress or Shopify build with custom design usually takes 2–4 weeks. Larger or more complex projects may take longer — I'll give you a realistic timeline upfront during our initial discussion.

faq.q: Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
faq.a: Yes. I offer post-launch support and maintenance for all projects. This can include content updates, security patches, performance monitoring, plugin updates and small feature additions. We can set up a retainer or handle things on a per-request basis, whichever works best for you.

faq.q: How do we communicate during the project?
faq.a: Primarily via email. I'm responsive and typically reply within a few hours during working hours. For larger projects I use a shared Google Doc or Notion board to track progress, feedback and tasks. I provide regular updates so you always know where things stand.

faq.q: What information do you need to get started?
faq.a: A brief overview of your business, your goals for the website, any examples of sites you like, your target audience and your rough timeline. If you have existing branding (logo, colours, fonts) that's helpful too — but not required. We can figure out the details together.
